title: The abelian Zilber–Pink conjecture
summary: We prove the abelian Zilber–Pink conjecture over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$. Every irreducible subvariety of an abelian variety has only finitely many maximal atypical subvarieties, where atypicality is measured inside its smallest containing torsion coset.
family_title: Zilber–Pink in abelian varieties and the Siegel threefold

review.reason: Proves finiteness of maximal atypical subvarieties in the abelian Zilber–Pink setting.
